brief:
Settlers set fire to several vehicles and spray-painted hostile slogans during an assault on the village of Umm Safa, northwest of Ramallah, the Ma'an news agency reported. The attack marks the latest in a series of incidents targeting Palestinian communities in the area.

No additional details were provided regarding casualties, the extent of damage, or the response of Israeli security forces to the incident.
title: Settlers torch vehicles, spray hate slogans in Umm Safa attack
